notes: This minor release adds 36 direct generation jobs, one for each public pack that Bifrost's legacy embedded registry provides and packs/v0.7.0 did not ship: the Go standard-library errors, log, net, net/url, net/http, bytes, encoding/pem, crypto/x509, path/filepath, testing, concurrency and sync/atomic packs with their declarations, the testify assert and require packs with their declarations, the Node child_process declarations and summaries and Buffer declarations for JavaScript and TypeScript, and the Python os-command, security-sink and stdlib-api packs. Their authored models move to the version-independent schema-8 compatibility shape; shard payloads, identities, provenance, licenses and completeness are unchanged. Online acquisition installs only the pinned native bundle, so these packs were absent from runs that select a packs release. Lombok, Getset, Scala case-class, Python process-inputs and Node runtime-values remain source-only: they carry only rules or runtime values, and the pinned Bifrost 0.14.0 producer requires a resolving type, member or procedure lookup. All other jobs, recipes and the generator are unchanged from 0.7.0. Generation, integrity, compatibility and per-run completeness remain separate from behavior qualification. Rules 0.7.1 is needed for normal acquisition to select this pack release.
